title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork: Access Business Applications with Work IQ
description: Users can access Business Applications through Work IQ in Copilot Cowork and use Business Skills to complete end-to-end business processes grounded in their enterprise data and apps. This helps users move from finding the right business application to taking action across key workflows with less context switching.
